sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000179-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Horizon Wellness Center 179 on November 2, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 1 rebate of 3%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Influenza share floor of 55%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: declined by the Customer.
